data.title: Qualcomm issues warrants to Amazon to acquire $4 billion worth of chipmaker's stock as part of AI infrastructure deal
data.description: Qualcomm is trying to move into the data center business, where Nvidia has been the dominant player in the AI boom.
data.author: Ari Levy
